Class TotemPlacementHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.game.TotemPlacementHandler
public class TotemPlacementHandler extends Object
Executes the totem-placement action of a round.

In Mesos, every round starts with the players placing their totems on the offer path. The offer path decides two important things:

  • which immediate effect the player receives from the chosen space;
  • how many cards the player may later draw from the upper and lower card rows.

This class owns only that part of the game flow. It validates that the player is allowed to place a totem now, places the totem on the board, stores the standard draw quotas, and advances the round flow to the next player.

When the last totem has been placed, the class prepares the next phase: it resolves space A, asks the board for the offer-path resolution order, and changes the round phase from RoundPhase.PLACING_TOTEMS to RoundPhase.PLAYER_DRAWS.

Disconnected players are handled only at the turn-order level during this phase. A player who has already placed a totem remains on the chosen offer space. A player who has not placed a totem remains on the starting tile. The board is not used as a temporary parking area for disconnected players.

This class deliberately does not choose cards, resolve card effects, manage extra draws, reset the board, or compute the final score. Those steps belong to different handlers so that each rule stays small and readable.

  • Method Details

    • moveTotem

      public void moveTotem(Player player, String tileCode)
      Places the current player's totem on an offer space.

      The action is legal only when:

      • the game has already started;
      • the round is in the totem-placement phase;
      • the requesting player is the current player;
      • the requested offer space exists and is free.

      After a legal placement, the board returns the number of upper-row and lower-row cards that the player may draw later in the same round. Those numbers are stored in PlayerDraftState.

      Parameters:
      player - player placing the totem
      tileCode - code of the target offer space, for example "A"

    • handlePlayerDisconnection

      public void handlePlayerDisconnection(Player player)
      Handles a player disconnection during totem placement.

      The board position is not changed here. The physical position already tells what happened:

      • if the player already placed a totem, they stay on the offer space;
      • if the player is current and has not placed a totem, they stay on the starting tile and the turn advances;
      • if the player has not reached their turn yet, they stay on the starting tile and will be skipped only if still disconnected when the cursor reaches them.
      Parameters:
      player - player who disconnected
